description:
Julyoung looks human to the untrained eye, but is actually half human-half fox. His life consists mainly of curing the ailments of the sick. Him, and Poongwon, the girl who he took in as a child and raised as his own, not only save the lives of others but also help solve strange mysteries. After a reunion with his old friend Moojin, Julyoung aka Dr. Jul finds himself embroiled in another incident!

**English Translation:**  
[Manta](https://manta.net/en/series/avidya?seriesId=2755), [Renta](https://www.ebookrenta.com/renta/sc/frm/item/145949)
